notes.title: Patch 10.1 - Server Fixes
notes.content:
General
No new client update just yet, instead this post is mostly to cover a few of the server side issues that have been deployed that have been affecting gameplay.

Gameplay Changes

 Disguised units will now maintain their attributes applied to them. Attributes include: Poison, Plague, and Slow


Fixes

 Attribute text during hover over state should now be the correct size as ability text
 Crashers with 0 attack no longer can take out magic barrier
 Brawler unit should no longer be gaining extra health with eliminating another crasher
 Crashers with 0 attack no longer can take out the modifier wall in the middle
 Disguised units with more than 1 hp and hit by holy smite will no longer go back to full health when being revealed
 Disguised units revealed/shot within range of an ox totem will maintain their buffer for the turn
 Holy smite no longer reveals disguised units hit and survived


If you have read this far, make sure to join the discord!
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38809685/9640f42becf235bdc680b69103f5600806571083.png

notes.title: Patch 10 - Addressing Launch Needs
notes.content:
General
First off I would like to thank everyone that has come out this last weekend to play games. I have been working on this project on and off for 5 years now and It was so awesome seeing everyone out playing. I have started to note down issues being seen such as users only playing the tutorial and AI instead of queuing up for online matches. I would like to mention to join the discord! as its the best place to keep up to date or find others for a match as the game is in a growing state.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38809685/9640f42becf235bdc680b69103f5600806571083.png

Changes

 Updated the client so during any server interruptions you will be brought back to the main menu. Queuing up while the server is down will let you know
 Added hover and hit states to buttons throughout the game to help know what is clickable
 Added audio to go with button clicking
 Main menu will now showcase the server status in the top middle including player counts, people in queue etc 
 Updated the AI so it can play 3 different decks, changed a bit of its logic as well to hoping help it not get stomped 24/7


Balance Changes

 Fish: Attack 2 -> 0 | Health 3 -> 2 | Ether Cost 3 -> 0
 Moose: Attack 3 -> 1 | Health 5 -> 6 | Ether Cost 5 -> 4
 Kang: Attack 2 -> 4 | Health 4 -> 1
 The Revenant: Attack 2 -> 1
 Sean: Attack 3 -> 4
 Horntail: new ability Slow has been added


Fixes

 Event icons in the main menu were showing the wrong items being awarded to players
 Various server side crashes happening during the weekend
 Correction in the event prompt text

notes.title: Patch 0.5

This UI for veteran players will showcase attribute information such as units with Plague, Poison, or Slow which can last 1 to many turns long.

notes.title: Patch 0.4
notes.content:
General Notes

 Updating balance on a bunch of units to help shake out the meta
 Introduced Ririka; a new unit into the game
 New ability Absorb: Killing a unit grants +1 attack
 New ability Piercing Strike: Attack the lowest health unit behind the crasher you are attack.
 Fixed a variety of bugs including getting the game back in a playable state
 New VFX animations for various spells and abilities


Ririka
Ririka has two great abilities that work really well with each other. Piercing Strike that allows you to hit a unit behind the one you are attacking for free makes trading damage super valuable. The combination of that an Absorb that grants +1 attack on kill makes Ririka a very good scaling unit for clearing the board and keeping your opponent down!

Abilities
Piercing Strike
When attacking an enemy unit, also attack the lowest health unit behind that one without taking damage back.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38809685/f35ec4bf5eb573a49d48c5157c4cdff3c5c3ce2e.gif

Absorb
Killing a unit grants a permanent +1 attack to the unit

Fixes

 Fix: Issue where Quick guard ability was hitting multiple times if you hit multiple units within its radius
 Fix: Can no longer Quick guard totems
 Fix: New users joining the join were crashing the server, this has been fixed and new users are now welcome back
 Fix: Users were unable to buy Ethos currency from the store
 Fix: Clicking the Crasher pass was opening up a blank screen, now redirects the user to the store page
 New: Ethos currency price should show to the best of its ability the purchasing price in your local currency
 Fix: Crashers with large tooltips during hover would have the UI jitter


Balance Changes

 Abominable Skeleton: Mana 1 -> 4 | Health 6 -> 5 | Attack 2 -> 5
 Skeleton: Health 3 -> 1
 Frost Warrior: Health 2 -> 3 | Attack 5 -> 6
 Rodent: Mana 2 -> 1 | Health 2 -> 1
 Magic Barrier: Mana 4 -> 2
 Necromancer: Mana 3 -> 2 | Health 4 -> 3

notes.title: Patch 0.1.10
notes.content:
Welcome to the new patch! 0.1.10 contains a bunch of new fun things in the world of Crashers

Store
New in game store is live! Purchase Ethos to spend in the in-game shop on the Crasher Pass and cosmetic items to enhance your Crashers experience.

Crasher Pass
With this update we are introducing the first Crasher Pass. Similar to events you will gain xp towards the pass by playing matches online. In later updates we will also have a few other ways to gain xp and they will be announced at a later date. The Pass contains two tracks: The free tier unlocks content every two levels while the paid Crasher Pass tier called "Premium" gets content every level including the free tier stuff. 

We hope you can all help support the testing of the pass.

Server
New server written from the ground up! Make sure to report any issues on the discord.

Cards

 Sean: Kings character with the new Double Up ability. Attacking grants double attack power
 Gremlins: 3 new fun Gremlins that each have an ability stolen from another region
 Borro: Has a built in Barrier and applies a slow modifier to anyone he hits
 Nicole:  Hitting or being hit by a friendly applies a heal
 CHANGE | Big Drill: Gains the Disable ability in which enemy totems are disabled for so many turns


Gameplay
With the addition of the Gremlin cards. When you run out of cards in your deck, taking damage on your turn rewards you with 1 or 3 available Gremlin cards to play down. This should help speed up gameplay and allow those that run out of cards first a chance to still win.

Emotes
Who doesnt like spreading a little joy in game! You can access your emotes in game by tapping on your players avatar in the bottom left. Collect new emotes from the Store or Premium Crasher Pass.

notes.title: Patch 0.1.9
notes.content:
Welcome to the new patch! 0.1.9 contains some new items around events and a bunch of general fixes.

Halloween 2021
This marks the one year anniversary of events inside of Crashers of Aetheria. To mark the special occasion we have brought back legacy skins from last years event. Play during this week online to unlock all the skins and get the new Halloween 2021 icon just for logging in.

Fixes

 Fixed accessing another screen while in queue would break the game (IE: Deck building)
 Can now access the settings while in game
 In game card selection X
 Deck builder now respects the amount of skins you have unlocked for a specific card
 Add to deck button state now properly works (will display if you can add, out of skins, or reached max)
 Variety of font color issues


End Game Rewards
To better help users see what they are getting unlocked, we have added in a end game rewards screens. Play matches during the event to see your progress and what you have unlocked.

notes.title: Patch 0.1.8
notes.content:
Welcome to the new patch! 0.1.8 contains the much needed new deck builder, promo codes and a new pre-game loading screen.

Deck Builder
This is v1 of the deck builder and plans for an updated v2 are already in the works. We wanted to get the current version in the hands of people testing to see how they enjoy the new experience.


 New visual design to help with the building of decks
 Skin! Yes now equip your skins while building your deck. Got more than 1 skin? No problem you can equip a skin for each entry of the character
 Can now name your deck; current users will notice their deck names appear with blank names so just go ahead in the deck builder and give it a name
 Ether cost histogram in case you're trying to balance your deck in a certain way. More versions of this histogram will come in v2
 Autosaving; don't worry we got your back. Whenever you change decks or go to leave we will autosave your deck for you


New Items

 Promo code; want to redeem some great rewards? check out our promo socials including discord for a sweet promo code that unlocks a ton of community designed skins.
 New pregame loading screen

 Much larger viewing area for cards
 Card skin selection
 Deck naming
 Personalize your deck by choosing the cover image
 Deck syncing for a better crossplay experience
 Auto saving
 Deck histogram to see how balanced your deck is

notes.title: Patch 0.1.7
notes.content:
Welcome to the new patch! 0.1.7 contains some new QoL features and bug fixes. Make sure to checkout the Balance Change specifically as there were a lot of mini adjustments being made.

New Items

 AFK check during queue; will now prompt you to accept the game. If someone declines on you, dont worry you are put back at the top of the list.
 Killing or removing a bear totem from play will unlock any frozen units attached to it. Normal placement/shooting rules apply.
 Twitch Banner: Check out the new banner in the main menu highlighting some of our favourite twitch artists including development streams.
 Discord has a new channel to see player count in game; head over the coa-status channel and check it out
 Discord gamelog visual updates
 Shooting highlight colour change and fixed issues on Medium and Large units


Bug Fixes

 (Mac only) fixing visual issue of not being able to see your card art in game
 If you have a unit that was currently in motion when you turn was up, it will continue until its down including any damage exchanges
 Trying to shoot a second unit while one was already firing no longer puts that Crasher in a can not shoot state AKA cancelling their shot.
 Abominable Skeleton no longer deals damage to units it hits while being created.
 Spawn position of the Abominable Skeleton is now where the hit unit was preventing possible bumping issues with other units.
 Changing your avatar in game no longer requires a game restart to show in a match.



Balance Changes
Necromancer

 Removed the 4 unit cap from the ability since we now have a general hand cap itself.


Skeleton

 Unit Size: Small -> Large
 Health: 1 -> 3


Abominable Skeleton

 Mana: 0 -> 1
 Health: 5 -> 6
 Attack: 4 -> 2

notes.title: Developer Log: August 2021
notes.content:
Welcome to the August developer log update!

Playtesting
We decided to leave playtesting fully open for those that would like to give Crashers of Aetheria a try! Play cross-platform with those on Google Play. While queues won't have as much action all the time I highly suggest either joining the Discord or coming to check out Calvin's art streams over on Twitch to find some of our great community members that are generally down for a game or two.

Summer Break
We are taking a little break throughout August to rest up and enjoy some summer sun. Don't worry though we will be back after a few weeks with more improvements and features for the game.

In Game Updates
Twitch Banner
To give a little back to all those that stream and mention the Crashers brand. We added a new banner in the main menu to showcase streamers that are online.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38809685/111a3a719053df517aac792aacebe600dd403e62.png

Discord Bot Updates
Did a few updates to the discord bot including a new dedicated channel to showcase the number of users online, in queue or in-game.

Adjusted the game changelog as well so it looks a bit more interesting including showcasing the winner's avatar.

Offline Mode
These last few weeks we have been working on bringing the offline mode to the game. Currently, it is showing a lot of promise to start bringing a new AI challenge to players looking to play the game. Hopefully, we can get this feature out soon for players so they can continue to enjoy the game.

Community Event
Back in June, we hosted a Discord event to let our community members submit some skin ideas for our Crashers characters. Shoutout to everyone that participated and we hope to potentially do another version sometime in the future.

notes.title: Developer Log: July 2021
notes.content:
Welcome to the July developer log update!

Playtesting
A little update on playtesting; it is going to happen to start this Monday, July 5th 2021 and will run until July 16th which is the last day to play. We will be hosting an in-game event during this time to hand out great rewards so make sure to log in and give it a try!

But I don't have access yet!
Don't worry just head to our steam page for the game and click the Request Access button and it will give you access to the game from Monday forward.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38809685/30f89bc45bb248a5611efef0df9347df2303e21b.png

Action Bar
This weeks focus has been adding the Action Bar to the game. This bar is located in the top right of gameplay and will give you a history of what is going on within the game. No more fear of looking away and wondering what happened to my team they were just there!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38809685/e731f5211865f5a7847669a1f26af39996ebf8e2.gif

Server Upgrades
This weekend we will be upgrading our servers in preparation for more players to enter testing. Hopefully, everything goes rather smoothly for the event.

New Cards
This last month has been pretty tight with system work within crashers but we did have time to sneak in a totem that has been waiting to see the day of life! 

Bear Totem
Disables enemy Crashers from being able to shoot while inside the radius of the totem. Very useful for locking out your opponent.

notes.title: Developer Log: June 2021
notes.content:
Hey Everyone!

First of all I would like to apologize for not updating Steam as much. The game itself is going strong and we added some more testers to our pool in the last 6 months to help with testing of new updates and features.

Instead of having multiple posts I am going to start doing one developer log per month to showcase all the fun things we have done and added into Crashers. Since there has been such a long gap here on Steam I will fill you in on the last 6 months and where we are looking at in terms of adding in more players and entering Early Access.

Request Access
The first stage of major testing for Crashers will take place for those that have used the new Request Access feature here on the Steam page. If you were an early adopter before this feature came out make sure to click that button. At the beginning of July 2021 we will let anyone in that has requested access and there are quite a bit of you ːsteamhappyː.

Early Access
After we have our testing phase we will start to integrate more features needed for Early Access things such as the skin store, Crasher Pass and locking cards so they can be unlocked through gameplay. Don't worry! our goal for everything pay wise is purely optional. Simply by playing the game will you be able to unlock all the cards currently available. We are shooting for a late July 2021 for Early Access but this could shift out depending if the servers need some extra work during our testing phase.

What Have You Been Doing All This Time!
Art Upgrade
Over the last few months we have been working hard to upgrade every single card, and skin in the game to the final art pass. You truly can see the difference and it looks amazing! We can not wait for everyone to see what it looks like.

This example showcases the new vs old art that was in the game
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38809685/5d848615cbee9af4f506f53d11976f987cfc89e1.png

[previewyoutube=ERILbQHMk3A;leftthumb][/previewyoutube]

New UX/UI
After our initial events we ran for closed testers during Halloween and Holidays 2020 we decided to go back to the drawing board and fully craft a great playable experience. The goal was to create an experience for the user that would get them as quick as possible into the action and make sure they only new the key information during the hand hold phase. Along with the new UX we also did a full redesign of both the in game and out of game UI. This UI is more in sync with the game as a whole and allows us to expand many great features into the game. In Game UI was completely overhauled to allow for the possibility of future gamemodes.

Upgrading Servers and Exploring Scalability
During the month of May we took some time to look into a better scaling option for the server. While we are not quite finished yet we made really good strides that could come one day in the future.

Trailer
We have been working hard on our launch trailer for the game. While I can not show too much off I will link a small clip showing the process of one of the scenes.

https://twitter.com/CrashersTheGame/status/1399761281784164352

Music
We started to integrate some new music into the game.

[previewyoutube=PoGCBz2kgPI;leftthumb][/previewyoutube]

Outro
I hope you enjoyed the little developer log update. Make sure to follow us on our social media platforms for the game. We will see you at the end of the month for an update on the Request Access testing period for the game.

Thanks,
Team at Red Panda Games
